address: 99/4 Mu 5, Nong Pa Khrang, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50000, Thailand
bio: This laid-back shop in a shady spot is known for its traditional Chiang Rai-style nam ngiao. Generous bowls of rich, tangy broth made with fresh coconut milk come with pork or beef, tomato and herbs. Sides and vegetables are also available. Busy at lunchtime, so be ready to wait.
